senses.zh_definition: 扎基尔：阿拉伯语来源的男性人名，词源含义为记念者，宗教语境中常联系记念真主。
senses.en_definition: Zakir, a masculine personal name of Arabic origin meaning one who remembers, especially one who remembers God.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas lelaki yang berasal daripada bahasa Arab, dengan makna asal orang yang mengingati, khususnya mengingati Allah.
senses.nuances: 此处作为专有名词说明，通常首字母大写。输入没有 DBP 定义，以上马来文为编写释义，不是 DBP 引文；尚无充分依据将小写 zakir 确认为通用马来语普通名词。status 依指定结构保留，不表示已核实 DBP 收录。以下为人名用法组合，不是具有固定词义的高频搭配。

etymology.historical_story: Zakir corresponds to Arabic dhākir, an active participle meaning one who remembers. In Islamic language, remembrance often concerns God, linking the name semantically with zikir. This Arabic relationship explains the name's meaning; it does not establish a productive Malay derivation or a verified DBP common-noun entry. The participle is described in [a Quranic concordance](https://www.altafsir.com/Books/Concordance_Of_the_Sublime_Quran.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Zakir 与 zikir 配对记：zikir 是赞念，Zakir 这个名字的词源是记念者；两者同源，但不是马来语换元音构词规则。
